fusions.name: Barred Muzzle
fusions.desc: Fires a slug that deals 40 damage to the first enemy it meets, ignores its armour and leaves it [Suppressed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Suppressing Fire
fusions.desc: Looses 3 shots in a spread, each dealing 6 damage with a 30% chance to leave the target [Stalled] for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Loophole Post
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to plant a gun post beside you for 20 seconds. Every 1.2 seconds it fires on an enemy within 7 tiles for 6 damage.

fusions.name: Return Fire
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, a shot strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles and deals 8 damage. Your armour rises by 5%. Once every 6 seconds.
